title: Lecture 7: Concentration inequalities
summary: This lecture notes covers concentration inequalities for random variables, including Markov's and Chebyshev's inequalities as foundations. It presents the Chernoff-Cramér method for deriving exponential tail bounds using moment-generating functions, with applications to Gaussian random variables, random walks, and binomial distributions. The notes introduce sub-Gaussian random variables as an important class for which strong concentration results can be derived.
